They even said to contact them any time if I have further complaints. So major props to them for that! They clearly truly care about their consumers and our experience.

I've been playing daily since downloading this game a couple months ago, and I'm now on level 1018. Crazy, I know. I like to play it while watching a show in the background. I've tried others in the same genre before, but never liked any enough to play long-term until this one. 

I only have ONE complaint, and that is that they don't offer a no ads purchase. I generally will not play any game in which I cannot remove ads, but this one is just so enjoyable that I'm breaking my personal rule for it. Please devs, consider offering a no ads option! I'd even pay a slightly higher than average cost just to give some support and a small thanks to the devs and for the game!

author: Anetzzz
title: Had to remove app!
content:
Third review: had to remove this app. Before recent 'updates' it was a calming activity. Now part way through, twice, the app suddenly completes parts of the puzzle, just randomly. Not only is this interference w user play, it robs me of puzzle completion satisfaction, devs- you had a great app and now it frankly sucks. I'm so disappointed -- I had been on the cusp of recommending Oakever apps in general to my friends for them having a number of actual calming games. Sadly, I cannot recommend due to the devs 'improvements' that detract from user engagement and satisfaction. Down to one star for this reason. 

Second review: downgraded to 3 stars: Now July 9, another update but in addition to the 'fake wisdom quotes' on app open ("use Colorever 60min a day for a good nights sleep" - so ridiculous of course there are NO studies that found this) and the occasional 'real wisdom quotes' from actual people (which, by the way, disappear too quickly to even read them), NOW we have another forced 'fake wisdom quote' for EVERY. SINGLE. GAME. Huge deterioration in quality and user relaxation. We're already using the app at that point so this timing of these types of quotes is plain pointless and just irritating. It actually causes me to use the app way less. 

Original 4 stars: Hey devs, after recent update I see you've added little sparkles to help us find out 'blank/empty' spots. Can we please make that an optional setting? I actually like the cognitive work of finding them myself. 

Update: Devs wrote me saying they liked this suggestion and would forward to the coding team.

 (But they just keep doing intrusion 'updates' so I don't think they seriously recognize anymore what a calming solid app they had pre-July 2026.)

I cave to check the app out, and it’s just as bad as the advertising. Absolutely terrible. Wouldn’t recommend. It’s just a cheap knock off of gem sort.

Not that I’m surprised though. None of these creators can think of a semblance of originality.

author: LadyFaust
title: Ads Lie: /NOT/ an Ad Free Game
content: Initially when you begin playing you are treated to 8 levels of ad free gameplay: you are lulled into a state of false complacency before ad after ad plays following each level, and given that they aren’t that difficult…it’s repetitive. Most interesting is no “remove ads” option, meaning this game would rather that sweet ad revenue money than let you pay to remove it.

author: Bearwiley
title: Love the game, hate the ads
content: Like others have said, you get 8-9 levels with no ads but after that, it’s an ad after every level. Please give us an ad-free option.  I’m more than happy to pay.  The ads don’t do anything other than make me delete the app. At least with a pay option, you’d make some money off me. Otherwise, it’s bye bye to another app killed by ads.

author: Crazyblazin
title: Too many ads
content: I love this game but there are too many ads. It’s quite annoying.

author: elixu0917@us
title: Good but something to improve
content:
It is good, especially the buffer area is large enough for 24 diamonds and that makes swapping easier. 
However, the way of picking diamonds needs to consider to follow the path how they can spread. For example for diamonds forming a shape of U turn. If I try to pick them from one end of the U turn, then it should follow the path how to write a letter U (from one end to the other), not from both ends at the same time then to the turning.

author: garrettb22
title: Ads
content: I get an ad about this game, claiming there are no ads. I play a few levels and then, BAM!!! Ads. Can’t give a good score if you’re going to lie in your ads.

author: Ninjed1
title: No ads
content: The ad i saw said no ads…and of course im not happy that there are ads

author: Another app that doesn’t work
title: Love these tile puzzles
content: I like the HARD puzzles. But…This one falls short. It isn’t precise enough to lay tile. I have to tap hard, tap several times to lay the tile. It’s annoying to have to try to place and pick up tiles. Not a fan.

author: xStephMarie
title: Ads after finishing every level
content: I truly like this app. It’s very satisfying finishing the level but there are ads after every single one which makes it so annoying. I wish there was a way to stop them.

author: Tazee724
title: Lies about Ad free
content: Only Ad free for the first maybe 9 levels then ads after every level. I absolutely hate games that falsely advertise no ads and then there are. Stop lying to us if you really want us to play your games!!!

author: smithsl1
title: Color ever
content: I like the fact it has two rows to put the extras in at the same time. The other games only have one, they open their second row near the end when you don’t need it. A third row or MORE would be even better but I like this one better. It’s satisfying when you can play more colors at once.

author: stupididneeded
title: Ads
content: I saw about 15 ads for this game.  Every ad said NO annoying ads.  I am sorry but all ads are annoying.  After every level there is an ad I have to fully watch to get to the next level.  I am going to take this off my phone as it is the latest one out of I don’t know how many have told me no ads.

author: SyrenNova
title: Ads after every level
content: I loved this game while I was able to play without an ad after every level. I played maybe ten levels and then every level after that has an ad upon completion. No ad free options.
